text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! American-style table manners?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I was invited by a distinguished family over there, but I'm not confident about my manners...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Since I'm representing the Mejiro family, after all. I was hoping you could check if I'm doing things right, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: OK! Leave it to me, you can ride this big ship with peace of mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eat meat boldly! Pile up mashed potatoes into a mountain!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Whoops, that's my family's house rules!
When dining out, let's seeee...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In America, forcing yourself to finish everything on your plate is a no-no!
If you're full, it's totally OK to say so honestly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, leaving food behind isn't viewed very positively in Japan, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Above all, just enjoy yourself! That is the number one manner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, this situation is the exact opposite of when I first came to Japan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Opposite? Ah, now that you mention it――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... I heard rumors, but cars really drive on the left!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And matching that, horse girl-only lanes have slightly different rules too, so be careful.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! Is this not how you hold chopsticks?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You can still eat holding them like that, Taiki, but it's not quite the proper way.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then please teach me! I'll surprise everyone with my good chopstick technique!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dober, Dober! Bow twice, clap twice, and bow one more time is shrine etiquette, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! You've really been studying hard.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Because I want to get used to Japan as fast as possible!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dober taught me so many things! Japanese manners, culture, and so on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I love Japan way, way, WAY more than before I came!! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Come on, you're exaggerating. Besides――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You made such an effort to learn about Japan on your own, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It kind of... gave me courage. Seeing such a positive attitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It made me think I should stop worrying so much and give things my best shot too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who should be saying thank you, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! In Japanese terms, that's holding and being passed to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Do you mean 'give-and-take'? Fufu, oh Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In that case, today I'll hold all the way! I'll even teach you witty jokes you can use at dinner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while walking through town――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dober! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Geez, you walk too fast!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry! But my excitement is non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Today is Dober's turn to hold! I'm super excited for this thank-you date!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Honestly, don't get your hopes up too high. ...Fufu.
